title: Weinstein on Rogan: Renaissance Technologies houses secret physics program
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Weinstein on Rogan: Renaissance Technologies houses secret physics program, about c. 2024 at Long Island, New York, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Weinstein is is on Rogan actively speculating that this is housing a sort of secret physics program involving all the top differential geometers in the US.
and the only exception I can find is that there's one black hole that you go into and you don't come out of called Renaissance Technologies that hires in these exact specialties.
tellings.difference: Told by Weinstein himself, framed as a 'black hole' that hires the exact specialties, and placed next to Brookhaven and Stony Brook; credits C.N. Yang.
tellings.link_reason: Both say Renaissance Technologies on Long Island quietly takes in the top mathematical-physics specialists, suggesting a hidden physics effort. Here Weinstein says it himself, where the story has Michels relaying Weinstein's words on Rogan.

as_told.title: Renaissance Technologies as a black hole that hires the needed specialties
as_told.place_text: Long Island, New York, next to Brookhaven National Laboratory and SUNY Stony Brook

tellings.quote: If there is a secret program, I'm pretty sure it's Renaissance Technologies.
tellings.difference: Told firsthand by Weinstein, who frames it as a 'Manhattan 3.0' on gravity and UAPs; the story's telling is the host relaying Weinstein's Rogan appearance about differential geometers.
tellings.link_reason: The same theory that Renaissance Technologies houses a secret physics program, here told by Weinstein himself.

as_told.title: Renaissance Technologies as the brain trust of a Manhattan 3.0 on gravity and UAPs
as_told.place_text: Renaissance Technologies, Long Island, New York

tellings.quote: Uh my former colleague, Eric Weinstein, you know, says that Renaissance Technologies and Jim Simons, you know, might be the center of the theoretical physics component of the UFO legacy program.
tellings.difference: Explicitly ties the secret program to the UFO legacy program and adds Stony Brook as part of the hub.
tellings.link_reason: Same Weinstein theory that Renaissance Technologies / Jim Simons houses a secret physics program, here framed as the theoretical arm of the UFO legacy program.

as_told.title: Renaissance Technologies / Stony Brook as theoretical hub of UFO legacy program
as_told.place_text: Stony Brook / Long Island, New York
